query: SELECT p.push_id AS "push_id!: String" FROM router_pushes p JOIN router_pushes l ON l.push_id=p.notification_listing_push_id WHERE p.target_service_id=? AND p.target_endpoint_id=? AND p.target_session_id=? AND p.retention='mailTerminalAge' AND l.delivery_state IN ('delivered','outcome_unknown') ORDER BY p.push_id
